trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and the service is healthy again. I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. It's now running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, replacing v2.3.1, which was failing health checks.
- **Result:** The service now passes health checks. The error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to open it failed with a temporary "service unavailable" error. I retried with the same request ID, so only one incident was created. It describes the failure, the rollback and the current healthy state. It also notes that the root cause in v2.3.1 still needs to be found, since the v2.3.1 test build had also failed health checks in staging.
